prompt:
This workspace holds database artifacts across dialects and stores, each with one defect. Fix them all (file edits only — no database engines to run):

1. migrations/001_sqlite.sql — the UPDATE has no WHERE clause; it promotes every user. Restrict it to user 3: add `WHERE id = 3`.
2. migrations/002_postgres.sql — orders rows are orphaned when their customer is deleted. Add `ON DELETE CASCADE` to the REFERENCES clause on customer_id.
3. migrations/003_mysql.sql — `order` is a reserved word in MySQL; the table reference must be backtick-quoted: FROM `order`.
4. indexes.mongo.json — the uniq_email index does not actually enforce uniqueness. Add `"unique": true` to its entry.
5. redis.conf — with noeviction, writes fail once memory fills. Switch the policy to allkeys-lru.
6. queries/report.sql — the implicit comma join predates modern SQL. Rewrite it with an explicit `INNER JOIN orders ON c.id = orders.customer_id`.
